**From:** Ruth Calloway  
**To:** Nadia Fennimore, Gideon Sato, June Osei-Lark  
**Date:** Jan 6, 2025  
**Subject:** Strategic pod: 2025 assignments  

Happy Monday all, hope everyone survived the holidays! I'm still digging out of my inbox and drinking coffee #3, pls forgive any brain fog.

Wanted to get our 2025 Strategic Accounts pod assignments down in writing before the 11am standup so June can update the routing tags. 

Here is where we're landing:

* **Nadia Fennimore:** You are officially owning both Vantorre Group and Orlavine Medical Supply. (Mateo Quiroga over at VTG already pinged me at 6am about the Gate 4 RFID scanner logs from their Newark yard, so I'll fwd that thread to you in a sec). Also for OMS, let's make sure their night-shift dispatchers in Salt Lake actually got the Pemberline Dock v4.2 patch note bc they were complaining abt the carrier drop-down menu freezing before Xmas.
* **Gideon Sato:** You're keeping Vantorre Mobility, just as you always have. No reason to mess with what works, especially while they are still re-striping the EV charging bays at the Allentown depot and moving all those morning slot templates around. 
* **Pooled / Pod:** Quillfeather Outfitters is staying a pod account worked on rotation. Since their Ogden warehouse is still buried in post-holiday returns at Doors 12–18, whoever is on the weekly rotation duty just needs to watch the open support tickets (especially #88412 on the bolster trailer turnaround report) and jump on their Wed afternoon check-in. 

I'll have Moss spin up the shared calendar rotation for QFO before lunch. See you guys on Zoom shortly!

Ruth
